file_impact.reason: THE FIX, and a deliberate departure from the ticket's original test-only plan: RebarArgumentParser.__init__ sets self.color = False, which in 3.14 is the entire knob (ArgumentParser._get_formatter calls formatter._set_color(self.color)) and is inert before it. Fixing the source rather than the assertions is what also fixes the two PRODUCT regressions a test-only change would have left: gen_cli_help.py --check reporting every committed help/*.txt stale, and RebarHelpFormatter._format_usage wrapping on rendered length that ANSI escapes inflate
the oracle: two regression tests that force FORCE_COLOR=1 and assert no \x1b appears in format_usage()/format_help(), including the subparser case; both confirmed RED without the _parser.py change
